 News School Holiday Tomorrow, November 13: Schools Closed in Meghalaya, Rajasthan; Check State-Wise Updates
 By Pratyasha Chaturvedi Last Updated: Nov 12, 2026, 20:17 IST School Holiday Tomorrow: Schools will remain closed in Meghalaya and Rajasthan on November 13, 2026. Check Delhi-NCR hybrid classes and state-wise updates. 
 School Holiday Tomorrow, November 13 Register for Result Updates Key Points
 No nationwide school holiday announced for November 13, 2026.
 Meghalaya schools closed on Nov 13, 2026, for the Wangala Festival.
 Rajasthan schools closed Nov 13, 2026, due to ongoing mid-term vacation.
 School Holiday Tomorrow: Schools across India will follow different timetables on Friday, November 13, 2026, depending on the regional festivals, state government orders and ongoing vacations. While schools in Meghalaya and Rajasthan will remain closed, students in several other states will have to attend regular classes. In Meghalaya and Rajasthan, schools will remain closed; students in several other states are expected to attend regular classes. 
 In Meghalaya, schools will observe a holiday for the traditional Wangala Festival. Meanwhile, Rajasthan schools will continue their scheduled mid-term vacation. In Delhi-NCR, younger students will have the option of hybrid learning due to worsening air pollution. There is no nationwide school closure announcement for November 13, 2026. Parents and students should check the latest instructions issued by their respective schools and district administrations.  
 School Holiday Tomorrow, November 13:- State-Wise Updates 
 Given below is the school holiday list for November 13, 2026, for various states. Parents and students are advised to check the latest information with the official notices or authorities of the school:- 
 State 
 Reason 
 Delhi-NCR 
 Schools are not completely closed across Delhi-NCR. However, students up to Class 5 will attend classes in hybrid mode following the air pollution concerns and the implementation of GRAP Stage III restrictions. Students can attend online or offline classes, depending on available facilities.  
 Meghalaya 
 Schools across Meghalaya will remain closed on November 13 to celebrate the Wangala Festival, also known as the 100 Drum Festival. The holiday applies to educational institutions across the state.  
 Rajasthan 
 Schools in Rajasthan will remain closed as part of the ongoing mid-term vacation scheduled from November 4 to November 15. Regular classes are expected to resume from November 16, 2026. 
 Uttar Pradesh 
 Schools are expected to remain open on Friday, as no state-wide school holiday has been announced for November 13, 2026. 
 Himachal Pradesh 
 Schools are expected to function normally, with no statewide closure announcement for the date.  
 West Bengal 
 Schools are expected to reopen on November 13, 2026, following the extended Puja vacation, which continued until November 12, 2026. Reopening schedules may vary between institutions.  
 Odisha 
 No statewide school closure has been confirmed for November 13. Students should follow their respective school instructions. 
 Bihar 
 Schools are expected to remain open as November 13, 2026, is not listed as a statewide school holiday. Chhath Puja holidays may follow shortly.  
 Also check, School Holiday in Meghalaya on Nov 13: Schools to Remain Closed for Wangala Festival 
 Will Schools Remain Closed Across India on November 13? 
 No, there is no nationwide school holiday on November 13, 2026. School closures will depend on state-specific festivals, vacation schedules, weather conditions and local administrative orders. Parents are advised to check school WhatsApp groups, official websites and circulars before sending their children to school. Students should also confirm whether online classes or revised timings apply in their respective areas.
